title: Red Lentil and Smoked Paprika Gravy
description: Red lentils dissolve into a smooth, smoky mushroom-broth gravy that brings body to lean pork or chicken.
equipment: Immersion blender and tall heatproof jug

steps.title: Warm the paprika
steps.text: Warm {oil} in the HexClad over low heat. Stir in {paprika} and {garlic} for 15 seconds until fragrant.

steps.title: Soften the lentils
steps.text: Add {lentils} and {broth}. Cover and simmer gently for 12–17 minutes, until the lentils crush without a firm center.

steps.title: Blend the base
steps.text: Puree the lentils and their broth until smooth, then return to the HexClad.

steps.title: Stir the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce to a simmer. Stir in the freshly mixed slurry and cook for about 1 minute, whisking until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Check the yield
steps.text: Measure the finished sauce in a heatproof cup. Aim for 1 1/2 cups total. If it measures short, whisk in a little hot water. If it measures over, return it to the skillet and simmer briefly to the mark.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon around thin slices of pork or braised chicken. A little extra gravy stirred through rice keeps the whole bowl moist.

notes: Yield: 1 1/2 cups. One serving is 1/4 cup. Make ahead: Cook and blend the lentils a day ahead and refrigerate the covered puree. Refrigerate in shallow covered portions within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze for up to 2 months. Stir in water to loosen the lentils when reheating. Fridge reheat: Bring a portion to a boil in a small pan, stirring until it reaches at least 165°F. Loosen with a little water as needed. Freezer reheat: Thaw in the refrigerator overnight and reheat as for a chilled portion. Option A uses sweet smoked paprika and garlic. For gentler Option B, halve the paprika, use sweet unsmoked paprika and leave out the garlic. The gravy is dairy-free. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/6 of recipe): 29 kcal, 1.3 g protein, 3.8 g total carbohydrate, 0.9 g fat, 0.5 g fiber, 5 mg sodium. The estimate covers the prepared condiment. Add separately served foods when totaling a meal.
